sql_statements.Q1:
SELECT ProductKey, EnglishProductName, list_price_units
FROM DimProduct WHERE list_price_units >= 1000000
ORDER BY ProductKey
sql_statements.Q2:
SELECT f.ResellerKey, r.ResellerName, SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimReseller r ON f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey
GROUP BY f.ResellerKey, r.ResellerName ORDER BY f.ResellerKey
sql_statements.Q3:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT ProductKey, channel, order_id, revenue_units, cost_units, profit_units FROM FactInternetSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ProductKey, channel, order_id, revenue_units, cost_units, profit_units FROM FactResellerSales
)
SELECT f.channel, c.ProductCategoryKey, c.EnglishProductCategoryName,
       SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units, SUM(f.cost_units) AS cost_units,
       SUM(f.profit_units) AS profit_units, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY f.channel, c.ProductCategoryKey, c.EnglishProductCategoryName
ORDER BY f.channel, c.ProductCategoryKey NULLS LAST
sql_statements.Q4:
SELECT g.CountryRegionCode, g.StateProvinceCode, SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimReseller r ON f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey
LEFT JOIN DimGeography g ON r.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
GROUP BY g.CountryRegionCode, g.StateProvinceCode
ORDER BY g.CountryRegionCode NULLS LAST, g.StateProvinceCode NULLS LAST
sql_statements.Q5:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT OrderDateKey, channel, order_id, revenue_units, cost_units, profit_units FROM FactInternetSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OrderDateKey, channel, order_id, revenue_units, cost_units, profit_units FROM FactResellerSales
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.FullDateAlternateKey, 'yyyy-MM') AS purchase_month, f.channel,
       SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units, SUM(f.cost_units) AS cost_units,
       SUM(f.profit_units) AS profit_units, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales f JOIN DimDate d ON f.OrderDateKey = d.DateKey
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.FullDateAlternateKey, 'yyyy-MM'), f.channel
ORDER BY purchase_month, f.channel
sql_statements.Q6:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT g.CountryRegionCode, g.StateProvinceCode, f.ResellerKey, r.ResellerName,
           SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units
    FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimReseller r ON f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey
    LEFT JOIN DimGeography g ON r.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY g.CountryRegionCode, g.StateProvinceCode, f.ResellerKey, r.ResellerName
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY CountryRegionCode, StateProvinceCode
        ORDER BY revenue_units DESC, ResellerKey ASC
    ) AS rank FROM totals
)
SELECT CountryRegionCode, StateProvinceCode, ResellerKey, ResellerName, revenue_units, rank
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY CountryRegionCode NULLS LAST, StateProvinceCode NULLS LAST, rank
sql_statements.Q7:
SELECT r.BusinessType, SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units,
       SUM(f.cost_units) AS cost_units, SUM(f.profit_units) AS profit_units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimReseller r ON f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey
GROUP BY r.BusinessType ORDER BY r.BusinessType NULLS LAST
sql_statements.Q8:
SELECT f.CustomerKey, SUM(f.revenue_units) AS revenue_units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
GROUP BY f.CustomerKey ORDER BY revenue_units DESC, f.CustomerKey ASC LIMIT 10
